lanes.proof_role: Complete six-card generation and acceptance-coverage proof
lanes.purpose: Verify all cards share generation 9, constraints and preparation review scope are explicit, every AC is covered by SPP and VPP, and #5350 plus the full AC-6 evidence contract are retained
argv: cards=%w[sip stp spp vpp srp sor].map{|k| JSON.parse(File.read(".csdlc/issues/5361/cards/#{k}.values.json"))}; abort("generation mismatch") unless cards.map{|c| c.dig("identity","generation")}.uniq==[9]; by_kind=cards.to_h{|c| [c.dig("content","card_kind"),c.dig("content","values")]}; abort("missing constraints") if by_kind.fetch("sip").fetch("operator_constraints").empty?; scope=by_kind.fetch("srp").fetch("review_scope"); abort("generic review scope") unless scope.include?("preparation revision") && scope.include?("AC-1 through AC-7"); stp=by_kind.fetch("stp"); abort("missing #5350 dependency") unless stp.fetch("dependencies").any?{|x| x.include?("#5350")}; ac=stp.fetch("acceptance_criteria").map{|x| x[/AC-\d+/]}.uniq.sort; spp=by_kind.fetch("spp").fetch("steps").flat_map{|x| x.fetch("acceptance_ids")}.uniq.sort; lanes=by_kind.fetch("vpp").fetch("lanes"); vpp=lanes.flat_map{|x| x.fetch("acceptance_ids")}.uniq.sort; abort("SPP coverage incomplete") unless spp==ac; abort("VPP coverage incomplete") unless vpp==ac; proof=lanes.map{|x| [x.fetch("proof_role"),x["defer_reason"]].compact.join(" ")}.join(" "); ["#5350","line count","module growth","dependency audit","test count","ci","exact-revision review"].each{|term| abort("missing proof term: #{term}") unless proof.downcase.include?(term.downcase)}; puts("cards=6 generation=9 acceptance=7 spp_coverage=complete vpp_coverage=complete shadow_parity=required ac6=complete")
